MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt']
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
RETURN p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE
       WHEN p.position IN ['Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Forward-Center', 'Center-Forward'] THEN 'Frontcourt'
       WHEN p.position IN ['Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Guard-Forward', 'Forward-Guard'] THEN 'Backcourt'
     END AS position_group,
     CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp_awards
WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL
RETURN position_group AS col1, MAX(mvp_awards) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE
  WHEN p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'F', 'C', 'PF', 'SF'] THEN 'Frontcourt'
  WHEN p.position IN ['Backcourt', 'Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'G', 'PG', 'SG'] THEN 'Backcourt'
  ELSE NULL
END AS position_group,
CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp_awards
WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL
RETURN position_group AS col1, MAX(mvp_awards) AS col2
